name: claude-mods

plugins.name: auto-continue
plugins.description: When the 5-hour usage limit is hit, wait for the reset and send "continue" automatically.

plugins.name: session-sidebar
plugins.description: A right-hand sidebar for the session: every link mentioned, things to know, and action items you tick off into a collapsible Done list.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. By Karan Bansal (vendored).

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons. By Anthropic (vendored).

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time. By Anthropic (vendored).

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Finds reusable corrections in your short prompts and saves them to CLAUDE.md from a band above the prompt. By Bayram Annakov (vendored).

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow plus a live panel of subagents with model, context, cost and time. By johnnyvizz (vendored).

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Orchestrated delivery flow: the session model plans and reviews, five tiered worker subagents implement. By johnnyvizz (vendored).

description: Personal Claude Code mods: my own plus vendored third-party ones, kept in one place.
